[comment by yungnickyoung (member)]
This is due to Mohist forcing you to use a newer Java version, when 1.16 mods expect to be run on Java 8.

I believe TelepathicGrunt fixed this issue by applying the `@Mutable` annotation to any accessor mixins modifying `final` fields. https://github.com/TelepathicGrunt/RepurposedStructures/commit/0b4be21a90b2b6f2288ff25bc36961d61ce7ab24#diff-75ef38585412525c2a469e918ffb2de8eeff9423b369c17eee19753ab1354e86R14

I'll experiment with this change soon and hopefully it will fix the problem.
